name: godot
description: Drive Godot with your AI coding agent via godot-cli: create a project, install the plugin, log in, and open the editor connected to ai-game.dev — automatically.

interface.shortDescription: Create, connect & build Godot games with AI via ai-game.dev.
interface.longDescription: Teaches Codex to drive Godot end to end through the godot-cli npm package: scaffold a C# (.NET) project, install the Godot-MCP addon, log in to ai-game.dev, open the editor in Cloud mode, confirm the connection, and wire the project's MCP tools — so you can build a Godot game just by asking.
defaultPrompt: Set up a new Godot game with AI and connect it to ai-game.dev.
Open my Godot project with AI and wire up the MCP tools.
